items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Do you remember any of the blues that Chris Kelly used to play? ... Well, he used to play so many different blues.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the blues that Chris Kelly used to play? Were they just make up blues or other tunes that you remember?

Well, he used to play so many different blues. I'm telling you the truth. Some blues he used to play, I'd have to take of them. He did some sad blues, you know. Yeah. He used to make so many different, like that piece, what Buddy P.T. used to put in there. Down, down, down, down, down. That was some pretty stuff then. And then fall down low, you know, and get down into blues. You know, it was really wonderful at that time. Did Chris? Of course, if he was here now, I think it would take with this rock and roll,…
